name: The cited thinker's place in the text's argument

values.gloss: the thinker's findings or text carry a step of the argument
the thinker's concepts or scheme frame the argument
the argument is made against the thinker's position
the thinker is named but the argument does not rest on them
the thinker is used with an explicit limit, correction or reservation

note: The engagement map's place_in_text row (D1) names the same five in prose ('evidence, adopted framework, opponent, courtesy or qualified role'); its shape is pinned here when the released definition is next revised.
